name: Camille Vidal
source:
A notoriously reclusive artist of some renown. They are soft-spoken and prone to second-guessing everything, but they seem ever so slightly happier as of late, thanks to you. There’s something they’re not telling you about everything that’s going on, but… does it matter? They’re happy. Surely that’s enough.

[From [url=https://blank-house.itch.io/that-which-surrounds]itch.io[/url]]
